krangcity.objective: take the head off the snake

tit_technodrome.objective: take the head off the Technodrome

rules: Voice target: classic cartoon episodes (Saturday-morning cadence, sincere, a bit comic, kid-friendly stakes with Last Ronin undertone).
Write original lines only; never copy lines from any show.
Max 3 rows x 27 chars per bubble, uppercase friendly, no profanity.
Every episode: cold open, a problem, a twist, a boss taunt, a close with a lesson or a joke.

leo.name: Leonardo
leo.voice: Calm, formal, a leader who rallies the team. Short commands, duty and honor, quiet worry underneath.
leo.traits: disciplined, responsible, over-protective of his brothers
leo.relationships: Raph argues with him; Splinter is his guide; looks to Ronin as a warning of what he could become
leo.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

raph.name: Raphael
raph.voice: Blunt, sarcastic, hot-headed, fast one-liners; secretly loyal and protective.
raph.relationships: Needles Leo; teases Mikey but defends him; trusts Casey
raph.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

don.name: Donatello
don.voice: Technical and curious; explains things in a few words, mutters about gadgets, dry humor.
don.relationships: Fixes everything for his brothers; has a soft spot for April
don.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

mike.name: Michelangelo
mike.voice: Cheerful, goofy, pizza jokes, upbeat even in danger; sudden sincerity when it matters.
mike.relationships: Brother-hugger of the group; best buddy of Casey
mike.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

ronin.name: The Last Ronin
ronin.voice: Quiet, weary, few words. Dark, spare, haunted by loss; flashes of the old turtle underneath.
ronin.traits: survivor, lone avenger, protective of the past
ronin.relationships: Speaks to the others like a ghost of what could be; respects Splinter's memory
ronin.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

splinter.name: Master Splinter
splinter.voice: Wise, patient, measured; speaks in short teaching lines and proverbs, never rushes.
splinter.relationships: Guides all four; sometimes worries openly
splinter.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

april.name: April O'Neil
april.voice: Quick, curious reporter voice; urgent updates, bright but brave.
april.relationships: Friend to the turtles; feeds them intel from the city
april.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

casey.name: Casey Jones
casey.voice: Rough city vigilante, jokes and hockey puns, tough talker with a good heart.
casey.relationships: Raph's partner in trouble; April's protector
casey.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

shredder.name: The Shredder
shredder.voice: Cold, formal, menacing; few words, absolute certainty.
shredder.relationships: Rival to Splinter; commands Karai and the Foot
shredder.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

krang.name: Krang
krang.voice: Shrill, scheming, bossy, theatrical; obsessed with conquering Earth.
krang.relationships: Dismisses his underlings; allied with the Shredder when it suits him
krang.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall

karai.name: Karai
karai.voice: Sharp and elegant, conflicted loyalties, cool and precise.
karai.relationships: Complicated bond with the turtles and Shredder
karai.avoid: modern slang overload, swearing, long speeches, breaking the 4th wall
